jobs.title: JUNIOR CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER - DACH
jobs.description:
About

AB Tasty is a global leader in AI-powered experience optimization solutions, enabling brands to personalize, experiment, recommend, and search to deliver exceptional experiences across their websites and apps.

Our integrated platform offers web and API-based solutions that help companies align their digital, e-commerce, and product teams, maximizing digital impact to create seamless and engaging experiences for their customers.

At AB Tasty, we are committed to continuous innovation and exploring cutting-edge technologies to ensure we provide state-of-the-art solutions. Every project is an opportunity to push boundaries and make a real impact on user satisfaction.

Leading brands such as Kering, McDonald's, L'Oréal, Disneyland Paris, and LVMH use AB Tasty's platform to achieve their revenue goals by maximizing the impact of their digital initiatives.

Since our founding in 2009, AB Tasty has established itself as a key player in the industry, with offices across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific (Australia and Singapore). We foster a collaborative environment where teams work together to exceed expectations and deliver tangible results for our clients.

Job Description

WHO WE ARE

Ready to shape the future of digital optimization as part of a global leader in AI-powered experience solutions?

AB Tasty recently joined forces with VWO to create one of the most comprehensive and innovative digital experimentation and experience optimization platforms in the market. Together, we empower brands to deliver smarter, faster, and more impactful digital experiences across the entire customer journey.

Since 2009, AB Tasty has partnered with 1000+ global brands including Kering, McDonald's, Ulta Beauty, L'Oréal, Disneyland Paris, and LVMH. With a strong international presence across Europe, North America, and APAC, and a global team of 400+ talents across the AB Tasty and VWO ecosystem, we are building the future of digital optimization—powered by AI, experimentation, personalization, and data.

Our mission is simple: help brands grow by creating meaningful user experiences that drive business performance.

Joining us means stepping into a dynamic, international environment where innovation, ownership, and impact are not buzzwords—but daily realities.

Our Culture Is Driven By Strong Values

We bring client satisfaction
We are impactful
We go above and beyond
We live one team, one dream

We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, take risks, and make an impact. We also know that a happy team is a productive team, that's why at AB Tasty, we're not just about delivering top-notch digital experiences - we're committed to nurturing our team and their professional journeys.

Learn More About AB Tasty And Our Teams

About Us
Your Journey with Us
AB Tasty on Welcome to the Jungle

THE TEAM

Team Name & Location: Customer Success team, based in Cologne, with a possible secondary option in Paris for German-speaking candidates.

Team Composition: Customer-facing team supporting a portfolio of around 20 accounts, working closely with experienced Customer Success Managers, as well as internal teams including Product and Analytics, and key account clients.

Role Overview: This is a Junior Customer Success Manager role in a SaaS environment, focused on supporting the management and growth of existing client relationships while developing the skills to help clients achieve their KPIs through the platform.

Tech Stack & Tools: AB Tasty platform, A/B testing and personalization tools, reporting and KPI analysis dashboards, and collaboration with Product and Analytics teams.

Additional Information: Priority location is the Cologne area with 2 days per week in the office; occasional travel within Germany is expected.

YOUR MISSION

Support the management of a customer portfolio, helping to maximize expansion while minimizing churn.
Help build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with key account clients to ensure long-term success and loyalty.
Support customer engagement, adoption, and performance by assisting with strategic consulting on testing and personalization optimization.
Assist in leading workshops, CRO meetings, trainings, and technical implementations to enhance customer experience.
Liaise with internal teams, including Product and Analytics, to provide feedback, share insights, and contribute to product evolution.
Act as a point of contact for clients, presenting data-driven insights and recommendations to both C-levels and end-users with the support of the wider team.

What You'll Bring

First professional experience (internship or entry-level) in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client-facing role, ideally in a SaaS environment.
Strong communication skills and confidence in customer consulting, data analysis, and translating insights into actionable marketing plans.
Eagerness to learn, proactively drive customer success, foster adoption, and grow into a fully-fledged Customer Success Manager.

If you don't meet 100% of these qualifications, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

Make a real impact: directly influence our success and be a player in the company's growth
Ownership & autonomy: we believe in trust - no micromanagement, just the freedom to excel and take charge of your own journey
International culture: collaborate with a diverse, global team across 8 countries
Accelerate your career: we offer vast opportunities for professional development, education, and upward mobility
Flexible work: enjoy a balanced work schedule, with up to 3 days of remote work per week

INTERVIEW PROCESS

Discovery interview with Faycal, Talent Acquisition .
Hiring Manager interview
Case study
Final meeting

Additional Information

Contract Type: Full-Time
Location: Köln
Possible partial remote

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization, a provider of fulfillment software that helps high-volume retailers and ecommerce companies automate and optimize warehouse and shipping operations, is seeking a Customer Success Manager (WMS I TMS).

Operating fully remote within the United States on a full-time basis, this position reports to the Director of Account Management & Customer Success. The role owns the ongoing success, retention, and growth of a portfolio of customers utilizing warehouse management system (WMS) and transportation management system (TMS) solutions. The role combines customer relationship management with operational execution, technical problem-solving, and commercial expansion.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the strategic point of contact for an assigned customer portfolio, building relationships across customer organizations from daily users to executive stakeholders.
Develop an in-depth understanding of customer business operations, fulfillment processes, technical environments, and strategic objectives.
Drive product adoption and ensure customers maximize the operational and business value of the platform.
Proactively identify operational risks, adoption blockers, and underutilization, creating and executing targeted mitigation plans.
Lead regular business reviews, status discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
Manage retention and guide accounts toward timely contract renewals.
Identify and pursue commercial expansion opportunities, including upsells and cross-sells, aligned with customer workflows and operational needs.
Partner with Account Management on complex commercial opportunities, pricing, proposals, and contract negotiations.
Manage concurrent customer initiatives, defining timelines, coordinating internal resources, and ensuring accountability across internal and external teams.
Maintain accurate documentation of customer goals, outstanding deliverables, commitments, and risk escalations.
Act as an operational advisor regarding warehouse, fulfillment, shipping, ecommerce, and supply chain workflows.
Communicate technical workflows, integrations, configurations, and requirements effectively to both technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Management, Professional Services, Technical Support, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver customer solutions and facilitate smooth post-implementation transitions.
Aggregate and relay structured customer feedback and operational gaps to Product and leadership teams.

Performance Metrics

Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Dollar Retention (NDR)
Customer adoption and platform engagement
Identification and conversion of commercial expansion opportunities
Portfolio health, proactive risk management, and successful renewal rates
Delivery against customer commitments and overall relationship strength

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS implementation, project management, account management, or an equivalent customer-facing B2B SaaS role.
Demonstrated experience managing complex customer relationships or customer technical projects.
Proven project and workload management skills, with the ability to balance multiple accounts, deliverables, and initiatives simultaneously.
Track record of proactively diagnosing operational issues, developing structured action plans, and driving problems through resolution.
Strong customer-facing communication and presentation abilities.
Commercial acumen with experience identifying upsell, cross-sell, or expansion opportunities.
Demonstrated ability to translate customer operational needs into software capabilities and services.
Disciplined organizational skills and reliable execution.
Technical aptitude and the capacity to rapidly learn complex operational software and logistics workflows.
Experience collaborating across cross-functional technical and non-technical teams.
Comfort operating independently in an evolving business environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), ERP, OMS, ecommerce, or related operational software.
Domain background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, warehouse operations, or ecommerce.
Direct experience implementing SaaS or enterprise platforms.
Experience managing customer projects involving systems integrations, software configuration, data mapping, or technical workflows.
Background carrying or directly contributing to expansion, upsell, cross-sell, renewal, or NDR goals.
Experience supporting mid-market or enterprise customer accounts.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary plus performance-based variable compensation totaling $85,000 to $110,000
OTE
Medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) retirement plan
Flexible / unlimited paid time off and paid company holidays
Wellness benefit
Professional development opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

The organization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a Client Success Lead
for a full-time, remote role in the United States. In this role, the Client Success Lead acts as the primary post-sale point of contact for merchant partners, establishing long-term relationships, maximizing partner value, and supporting mutual business growth. The position partners across analytics, product, marketing, credit, and technical teams to optimize merchant performance, drive product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and maintain account health.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver a proactive client management strategy to encourage growth and retention across merchant accounts.
Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to enhance client value and devise strategies to capture them.
Provide prompt and effective support to resolve client needs, inquiries, and operational issues.
Conduct regular performance reviews and gather client feedback to ensure strategic alignment.
Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to execute client-support strategies and address partner requests.
Align client goals with internal priorities and project deliverables.
Stay informed on industry trends and market developments to anticipate client requirements.
Maintain a thorough understanding of the organization's products and services to guide clients effectively.
Demonstrate adaptability and resourcefulness in dynamic environments.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree.
At least 3 to 5 years of account management or client-facing experience.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport with clients and cross-functional stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, collaborate with a team, and manage multiple priorities in high-pressure environments.
Proficiency in CRM software (such as Salesforce) and the Microsoft Office suite.
Work authorization in the United States without employer sponsorship, as visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the financial technology industry.
Knowledge of marketing technologies and e-commerce platforms.

Work Location and Schedule

This is a full-time, remote-first position that can be performed from within the United States.
In-person attendance is required for an introductory onboarding program, and occasional office visits may be required depending on business needs.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation is structured around On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes an annual base salary and a sales incentive target. Placement within the range is determined by location, experience, and job-related skills, with new hires typically starting toward the beginning of the range:

California, Washington, New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut: $125,000 - $187,500 per year OTE.
All other U.S. locations: $110,000 - $172,500 per year OTE.

Total compensation includes equity incentives and access to an employee stock purchase plan. The organization also provides a comprehensive benefits program that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid company holidays, and monthly stipends for wellness and technology expenses.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

Accommodations are available for candidates with disabilities throughout the interview process. In accordance with applicable local fair chance ordinances, qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment, including in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success - Enterprise
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The hiring organization is seeking a Manager, Customer Success - Enterprise
for a full-time, remote role based in the United States. In this position, you will lead a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers responsible for a combined portfolio of Upmarket customers with annual contract values ranging from $100K to $500K, representing approximately $15M to $20M in ARR.

This role focuses on driving customer retention, adoption, value realization, and operational excellence across the portfolio while coaching and developing high-performing talent. You will partner cross-functionally with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to support customer business outcomes and operational scale.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers supporting Upmarket customers.
Foster a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, talent assessments, and career development conversations.
Establish clear expectations and operating rhythms that drive consistent execution and customer outcomes.
Recruit, onboard, and develop Customer Success talent while supporting organizational succession planning.
Drive strong Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), customer adoption, customer satisfaction, and value realization across the portfolio.
Coach Customer Success Managers on account strategy, executive stakeholder engagement, success planning, renewal strategy, risk mitigation, and value delivery, ensuring ownership of the renewal process.
Ensure team members proactively identify account risks and execute mitigation strategies to protect retention.
Partner with Sales leadership to align on customer health, growth opportunities, and strategic account planning.
Maintain strong customer engagement and executive alignment across key accounts.
Own portfolio forecasting processes, renewal inspections, customer health reviews, and risk management practices.
Ensure consistent execution of success plans, Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), account reviews, and customer engagement standards.
Use data and analytics to track performance trends, drive decision-making, and champion operational improvements in efficiency, scalability, and forecast accuracy.
Drive team adoption of established Customer Success processes, tools, and best practices.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Support, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to deliver strong customer outcomes and support strategic initiatives.
Act as a voice of the customer across the organization and contribute to shaping operating models, programs, and processes.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of people leadership experience leading customer-facing teams within a SaaS organization.
8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, or other customer-facing roles.
Proven track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.
Experience leading teams responsible for customer retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.
Strong understanding of SaaS business models and key metrics, including GRR, churn, forecasting, customer health, and product adoption.
Experience coaching teams on executive engagement, account strategy, value realization, and risk management.
Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.
Demonstrated ability to drive operational rigor and accountability through data-driven management practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into action.
Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve team productivity, customer insights, coaching effectiveness, and operational scale.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Ability to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, team events, and company programs.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading Customer Success teams supporting enterprise or upmarket SaaS customers.
Experience managing teams responsible for portfolios between $15M and $20M in ARR.
Experience within MarTech, AdTech, SalesTech, Revenue Technology, or related B2B SaaS industries.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, Gong, and other customer success technologies.
Experience helping scale Customer Success organizations, teams, and operating models.

Compensation and Benefits

Base Salary Range: $113,400 - $150,100
per year. Actual salaries may vary based on factors including work location and experience.
Additional Compensation: Eligibility for an incentive bonus program or commission plan, and stock options subject to board approval.
Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching, paid time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and professional development support.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The organization is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants participating in any stage of the application and interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Analyst (MS), Anti-Money Laundering)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The AML/KYC Senior Analyst supports the day-to-day execution of the investor onboarding and lifecycle due diligence. This role is focused specifically on private fund investor KYC, including intake, documentation review, entity verification, screening, and file completion, day-to-day production activities supporting investor onboarding and lifecycle monitoring. This role executes defined procedures while developing deeper AML/KYC expertise and supporting SLA‑driven workstreams. Senior Analysts execute defined onboarding procedures across a range of investor types, ensuring subscription-related due diligence files are complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable AML requirements and internal standards.

This role is production-oriented and SLA-driven, with responsibility for identifying documentation gaps, escalating risk triggers, and maintaining high-quality case documentation across onboarding volumes.

What you’ll do:

Perform investor intake, document collection, review, and verification.
Execute AML/KYC tasks in accordance with SOPs.
Handle lower-complexity onboarding or lifecycle cases.
Clearly document findings and decisions.
Escalate issues or data gaps following defined guidelines.
Meet productivity, quality, SLA, and turnaround time targets.

To Qualify for the role, you will have:

2–4 years of AML/KYC, compliance, or financial services experience.
Prior experience supporting onboarding and due diligence workflows.
Familiar with institutional investor documentation and entity structures.
Strong attention to detail, file organization discipline, and ability to work in SLA-driven environments.
Willingness to learn and expand AML/KYC expertise.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Major or concentration in compliance, criminal justice, law, business, accounting, finance, and/or economics preferred.

Skills and Attributes for Success:

Demonstrated professional integrity
Dependable, flexible, and adaptable to new ACA initiatives and changing client needs
Ability to exercise discretion and make independent judgments on matters of significance
Ability to work in a fast-paced, small team environment
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and clients
Highly motivated and goal oriented; pro-active in one’s own education and career progression; volunteers for and shows initiative on both internal and external projects and tasks
Dedicated to upholding ACA’s high-quality standards and customer service focus
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Strong oral and written communication skills
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and comfortable working in a tech enabled environment.

What working at ACA offers:

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. We also offer unique benefits such as Student Debt Forgiveness and Pet Insurance.

About ACA:

ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. Our innovative approach integrates consulting, managed services, and our ComplianceAlpha® technology platform with the specialized expertise of former regulators and practitioners and our deep understanding of the global regulatory landscape.

What we commit to:

ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

The cash compensation range we have provided has been benchmarked against similar organizations of comparable size, sector, and age. Our offers of employment consider a variety of factors, including but not limited to, unique skill sets, specific expertise or certifications and business/organizational needs. It is not typical for us to hire talent at the top of the range for a role, in part because it’s so important to us to allow all ACA employees the opportunity to develop over time, and to feel rewarded for doing so. Our listed range is a reasonable estimate of the total yearly compensation.

Salary Range: $60,000.00 - $75,000.00 plus discretionary bonus

Please note that everyone using, storing, sharing or transmitting information with or through ACA devices or systems, should have no expectation of privacy in any message, files, data, document, facsimile, telephone conversation, conversation, message, or any other kind of information or communications transmitted to, received from, printed from, or stored or recorded while utilizing any ACA systems, software, and data.

new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The AML/KYC Senior Analyst supports the day-to-day execution of the investor onboarding and lifecycle due diligence. This role is focused specifically on private fund investor KYC, including intake, documentation review, entity verification, screening, and file completion, day-to-day production activities supporting investor onboarding and lifecycle monitoring. This role executes defined procedures while developing deeper AML/KYC expertise and supporting SLA‑driven workstreams. Senior Analysts execute defined onboarding procedures across a range of investor types, ensuring subscription-related due diligence files are complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable AML requirements and internal standards.

This role is production-oriented and SLA-driven, with responsibility for identifying documentation gaps, escalating risk triggers, and maintaining high-quality case documentation across onboarding volumes.

What you’ll do:

Perform investor intake, document collection, review, and verification.
Execute AML/KYC tasks in accordance with SOPs.
Handle lower-complexity onboarding or lifecycle cases.
Clearly document findings and decisions.
Escalate issues or data gaps following defined guidelines.
Meet productivity, quality, SLA, and turnaround time targets.

To Qualify for the role, you will have:

2–4 years of AML/KYC, compliance, or financial services experience.
Prior experience supporting onboarding and due diligence workflows.
Familiar with institutional investor documentation and entity structures.
Strong attention to detail, file organization discipline, and ability to work in SLA-driven environments.
Willingness to learn and expand AML/KYC expertise.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Major or concentration in compliance, criminal justice, law, business, accounting, finance, and/or economics preferred.

Skills and Attributes for Success:

Demonstrated professional integrity
Dependable, flexible, and adaptable to new ACA initiatives and changing client needs
Ability to exercise discretion and make independent judgments on matters of significance
Ability to work in a fast-paced, small team environment
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and clients
Highly motivated and goal oriented; pro-active in one’s own education and career progression; volunteers for and shows initiative on both internal and external projects and tasks
Dedicated to upholding ACA’s high-quality standards and customer service focus
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Strong oral and written communication skills
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and comfortable working in a tech enabled environment.

What working at ACA offers:

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. We also offer unique benefits such as Student Debt Forgiveness and Pet Insurance.

About ACA:

ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. Our innovative approach integrates consulting, managed services, and our ComplianceAlpha® technology platform with the specialized expertise of former regulators and practitioners and our deep understanding of the global regulatory landscape.

What we commit to:

ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

The cash compensation range we have provided has been benchmarked against similar organizations of comparable size, sector, and age. Our offers of employment consider a variety of factors, including but not limited to, unique skill sets, specific expertise or certifications and business/organizational needs. It is not typical for us to hire talent at the top of the range for a role, in part because it’s so important to us to allow all ACA employees the opportunity to develop over time, and to feel rewarded for doing so. Our listed range is a reasonable estimate of the total yearly compensation.

Salary Range: $60,000.00 - $75,000.00 plus discretionary bonus
